title: feat(state): subject identity by external reference — one entity per external record, refused not guessed
context:
The contract freezes canonicalObjectKey (NFC, trim, collapse whitespace, case preserved),
externalKey(ref) = system/object_type/key and subjectOfRef(ref) = object_type:key. writeState
refuses a second active entity in a partition that carries an external key an incumbent
already carries (409 conflict, incumbent named) and a commitment or derived statement whose
subject is the external key of a record an active entity carries (422 identity, entity id
named). A subject no entity claims stays free- Touches invariant(s): con_902759b3dc (All JSON writes to .hunch/ must be atomic (temp-file + rename) so an interrupted write can never truncate the index); con_a87360128b (Semantic vectors are a derived layer in SQLite, never the source of truth; reconcile by content hash on reindex).
decision: Introduced src/core, src/store, test/state-contract.test.ts, test/state-entity-identity.test.ts: added canonicalObjectKey, externalKey, subjectOfRef, entityIndex, subjectAliases, assertExternalIdentity, prov, principal; new dep(s): node:test, node:assert/strict; 1 new file(s).
